title: Page 25
transc:
September or October fifty nine period
Wet more says he saw him
last in image spring of sixty
one has not heard from him
for last two years period Hamilton
says he has heard from him
within two weeks and adds he
got half a million in gold
& currency period I have a
statement of his Confederate wealth &
operations in Neptune where he was
known as venus Lester <insertion>Leicester</insertion> cut from 
a Brook Lynn paper of thirtieth
ultimo which I can send if
you desire it period Your dispatch
rec'd signed A B Daven port
John Horner


Balto Feb 9th 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. M.
Audit I have made every
effort to obtain a map
of the City of Richmond
but regret that I am
unable to procure one Lockwood
GW Baldwin
